request.initial_prompt: *I am aware that down to the present time, the fish styled Lamatins and Dugongs (Pig-fish and Sow-fish of the Coffins of Nantucket) are included by many naturalists among the whales. But as these pig-fish are a noisy, contemptible set, mostly lurking in the mouths of rivers, and feeding on wet hay, and especially as they do not spout, I deny their credentials as whales; and have presented them with their passports to quit the Kingdom of Cetology.
request.hotwords: I, Lamatins, Dugongs, Sow-fish, Coffins, Nantucket, But, Kingdom, Cetology

raw_segments.text: I am aware that down to the present time, the fish styled Lamatins and Dugongs, Pig-fish and
Sow-fish of the Coffins of Nantucket, are included by many naturalists among the whales.
But as these pig-fish are a noisy, contemptible set, mostly lurking in the mouths of rivers,
and feeding on wet hay, and especially as they do not spout, I deny their credentials
as whales, and have presented them with their passports to quit the Kingdom of Cetology.
